Explanation: Creates an empty popup menu. It is hidden until it is opened.
Adds a command or a submenu to the popup menu.
Attaches a popup menu to a control. Right-clicking the control opens it, and so does Shift+F10 on controls such as text fields.
Opens the popup menu with its top-left corner at a position in the window.
Opens the popup menu where the mouse pointer is.
Returns an item's position measured from the corner of the window.
